subject: Poppr version 2.5.0 is released on CRAN

messages.author: c4aa0f0f1f26068a
messages.subject: Poppr version 2.5.0 is released on CRAN
parts:
Poppr version 2.5.0 has been released.

The binary for Windows users will be on CRAN within the next 24 hours. 

Copy and Paste this code into your R console:

install.packages("poppr", repos = "https://cran.rstudio.com")

Below you can find details of this release and other poppr-related news.


Details
----------

This release is mainly for compatibility with dplyr 0.7 and bug fixes, but the bug fixes were significant enough to warrant more than just a patch release.

Main points:

 - Fixed a bug in read.genalex() where entirely missing samples would accidentally shift the strata (details: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/issues/147)
 - For those who deal with polyploid data that have more than ambiguous alleles, Bruvo's distance will now consider all ordered combinations of alleles with the genome addition and loss models (details: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/issues/139)

A full list of changes can be found here: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/releases/tag/v.2.5.0

Poppr reference website
------------------------------------

I have launched a website for browsing the reference manual at https://grunwaldlab.github.io/poppr/

It contains examples that have been rendered so you can compare the output with what is expected. For example, here's the example for bruvo.dist: https://grunwaldlab.github.io/poppr/reference/bruvo.dist.html#examples


Cheers!
Zhian
